description.value: A provincial government-operated retail liquor store in Victoria's Cedar Hill neighbourhood, carrying wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders. Part of the BCLIQUOR chain of 198 stores across British Columbia, it offers a broad product selection including BC craft beers that might appeal to a touring cyclist looking to pick up local beverages. Staff are described as knowledgeable on product recommendations.
